title: Fixed sector sample prompts with exchange-style labels
points: Sector prompts generated from raw PSX labels such as INV. BANKS / INV. COS. / SECURITIES COS. no longer treat label words like INV or COS as unsupported ticker symbols.
The Equities page now phrases sector prompts as sector-scoped questions and includes a small covered-ticker sample to make routing less brittle.
Added the failed investment-companies announcement prompt to the equities sample eval, and swept the top public sector labels across overview, screen, announcement, and comparison prompt types.
